query.title: Business/company name or registration number
query.description: A business name, company name (or partial name), registration number, or incorporation/compliance number to search for. Purely-numeric input is searched as a number; anything else is searched as a name.

queries.title: Names or numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

entityType.title: Entity type filter
entityType.description: Restrict results to business names (sole proprietorships) or companies. "Any" searches both.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched records to return per search query.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many searches to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
